long: Mariano Busso, M.D., is a world-renowned cosmetic dermatologist whose 40+ peer-reviewed publications have redefined aesthetic medicine worldwide. He authored groundbreaking filler techniques for the cheeks, temples, and forehead, created the Busso Hand Volume Severity Scale, and introduced the global standard of adding lidocaine to fillers. Dr. Busso is the creator of the BussoLyft, a PDO thread lift used worldwide, and a key contributor to Allergan, Merz, Galderma, BTL, and Renovatio. He developed protocols for Ultherapy®, Vanquish™ ME, EMSCULPT®, EMSCULPT NEO, EMFACE, and EMTONE, and provides advanced Botox®, dermal fillers, PDO threads, skin tightening, body contouring, and skincare treatments.
